cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Really Happened?
cards.instruction: Find the truth by comparing details, repeating questions, and testing which parts of the story remain consistent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't lose the same bag in two places on this form. At four, were you on the bus or in the café?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: In the café. The bus was waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then 'on the bus at four' isn't accurate. Was the bag with you when you paid?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. The driver called me back before they'd made my coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need the hurried bit, not another location. Take me through getting back on, including what was in each hand.

reason: Keep overlapping café/bus chronology; A corrects an imprecise account and uses B's hurried departure to test the bag's movement, not merely announce procedure.
